title: ace: upstream policy port
note: Delayed platform-measured study-feedback port; not native reproduction. See methods/policy_ports/README.md for per-method mechanisms and differences.

preserved: Native ADD-only playbook patch parser, system-numbered bullets, helpful/harmful tags, deduplication and approximate playbook token bound.
Online keeps the current additive playbook despite regressions; offline final selection restores the measured study-best state.
adapted: Platform measures candidates between external-method calls; only adaptation-visible study channel is read.
Candidate trees are staged artifacts; historical parents are restored from platform states.
missing_until_runtime_support: Native within-call evaluator callbacks and separate dev capability; no held-out score or gold exposure.
Default native offline mode is retained, but offline winner uses study scores because a dev capability is absent.
Native target retries between reflections cannot run in a method call: max_reflection_rounds=1 is enforced, vs native default 3.
Training-batch/epoch order and periodic fresh dev evaluations are delegated to the platform fixed task set; no gold labels are exposed.

deviations.what: Method evaluation callbacks are replaced by delayed platform measurements.
deviations.why: INTERFACE.md §4 prohibits a method from evaluating benchmark tasks. The bridge reads only staged study records and returns whole candidates; it never invents a dev fitness or evaluates a held-out task.

deviations.what: Default native offline mode is retained, but offline winner uses study scores because a dev capability is absent.; Native target retries between reflections cannot run in a method call: max_reflection_rounds=1 is enforced, vs native default 3.; Training-batch/epoch order and periodic fresh dev evaluations are delegated to the platform fixed task set; no gold labels are exposed.
deviations.why: The source strategy and prompts are pinned under methods/policy_ports/vendor; README maps each source stage to this runtime and declares every unavailable stage.
